source_evidence.evidence: Savills chronological archive records the London & National sale on Monday 21 September 2015 with 256 offered, 218 sold, 85% success and GBP70,997,000 raised.

23 September 2015 report states Savills auctioned the East Dulwich outbuilding on Monday; guide GBP325,000, sold GBP440,000, 1,108 sq ft, former blacksmith workshop/outbuilding, planning permission for conversion to a two-bedroom home.
Savills London & National Residential & Commercial document lists 21 September 2015 as a forthcoming auction date.

lots.property_type: former blacksmith workshop / derelict outbuilding with residential conversion planning permission
lots.planning: Planning permission reported for conversion to a two-bedroom home with garden area.
lots.notes: Contemporaneous report identifies prior use as a blacksmith's workshop and sale through Savills on the auction date. Exact address and lot number are not evidenced in the surviving source and are deliberately left null.
